name: A_RESOLVE_ACCOUNT_OWNER
description: Offline email → account owner (the IAM/directory adapter, design §4). Input: email. Resolves against an embedded directory fixture mapping demo addresses to an account id, responsible OU, and contact. Unknown emails return { known: false } rather than throwing — fully offline, no network ever. Pairs with A_FETCH_HIBP (email in) and feeds A_REQUEST_RESET / A_FORMAT_ADVISORY.
